channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Minister calls for review after 81 Semporna lodgings found to be foreign-run
item.description: PAPAR: The Domestic Trade and Cost of Living Ministry has revealed that 81 accommodation premises in Semporna, Sabah, are operated by foreign companies and individuals.

item.title: Fans cheer for absent Ronaldo as Saudi row deepens
item.description: RIYADH: Al Nassr fans showed their support for Cristiano Ronaldo on Friday as the Portuguese star missed a second straight game after reportedly growing frustrated over transfers.

item.title: Volunteers share Malaysian flavours and kindness with Ottawa's homeless
item.description: THE snow was thick on the ground by the time the men offloaded the last of their haul.

item.title: Read the facts on border issue, Anwar tells critics
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim has dismissed accusations that Malaysia ceded territory to Indonesia, urging critics to "read" the facts of the long-standing border issue before making claims.

item.title: Aruwin carries Malaysian hopes at Milano Cortina Winter Games
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Alpine ski racer Aruwin Salehhuddin is Malaysia's sole representative at the Milano Cortina Olympic Winter Games which officially opened in Italy yesterday (Feb 6).

item.title: Sabah's forest defenders: Rangers in multi-agency operation battle wildlife crime
item.description: PENSIANGAN: The Integrated Khazanah Operation (OBK) has contributed to the protection of natural heritage, said Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Minister Datuk Seri Arthur Joseph Kurup.

item.title: Six students test positive for TB in Kota Tinggi, schools sanitised
item.description: KOTA TINGGI: Thorough sanitisation and cleaning works have been carried out at several schools here following the detection of six students who tested positive for tuberculosis (TB).

item.title: #NSTviral: Snake hitches ride with food delivery rider, video goes viral [WATCH]
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A food delivery rider was startled when a snake was found coiled around his motorcycle wheel rim, prompting netizens to joke: "Even the snake wants delivery."

item.title: GPS to hold first general assembly on April 19
item.description: KUCHING: Gabungan Parti Sarawak (GPS) will convene its first general assembly since its establishment in 2019, scheduled to take place on April 19.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Former Elite member Hana Adnan ties the knot
item.description: ​KUALA LUMPUR: Former Elite group member Hana Adnan, 48, has surprised fans with the news that she is officially married to former professional football player, Rudie Ramli.
